author: Author McKenna Roszkowski
title: Looking to commission character art for YA fantasy novel
content: ✨Calling all fantasy character artists! 🗡️ I’m looking to commission character art for my YA fantasy novel! I have a particular art style in mind, but I’d love to explore different artists and their work! Please drop your portfolio or commission links below! ♡ Contact: reply to the post with portfolio.

author: Cassidy Cole | Romance Author
title: Looking for character artists for published and upcoming books
content: Looking for character artists who have openings to do some character art for a few of my published and upcoming books!! (Absolutely no AI) Contact: comment or DM; author is reaching out via DM/Insta.

author: Or Cole
title: Looking for character artist for upcoming romance book (flexible payment)
content: I'm looking for an artists that can do character art for my up coming book. And who's willing to work with me because money is tight. So a lot up front wouldn't work but I can definitely pay you what you're worth. Just not up front. No AI please. I am so fucking serious no AI please! I am a romance author. Contact: reply to post.

author: Bea Paige
title: Looking for realistic character art artists for next WIP
content: I’m looking for character art artists who draw more realistic style art for my next WIP (absolutely no AI and will need to provide sketch proofs / videos) tIA Contact: comment on post or DM.

author: Aurora Crate Book Box
title: Looking for artists with availability through end of 2026
content: We’re looking for some artists with availability between now and the end of 2026. Self recs welcome, please include price list + some examples. No dms please. Also to clarify, NO AI - human artists only please. Contact: comment with portfolio, prices, examples. No DMs.

author: sega_jenesis_
title: Commissioning illustrated Pokémon scenes for custom card binders
content: 🎨 I’m on the hunt for digital artists! 👀 I’m planning to order some custom Pokémon card binders as holiday gifts, and I’d love to commission an artist to create a scene or two for them! I’m thinking full illustrated Pokémon scenes, not just individual characters. Obviously, this is a PAID commission! I absolutely believe in compensating artists for their time and talent. If you’re an artist or know someone who might be interested, please send them my way! I’d love to see portfolios, pricing, and availability. Contact: reply or DM.
